author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Alex Jones to discuss his vision for becoming Mayor of London and what that would actually mean for the city. Russell lays out his case for direct democracy as a revolutionary alternative to the current political system, arguing that real power should be returned to ordinary people, regardless of socioeconomic background. The conversation gets into what genuine democratic reform could look like and why Russell believes the current system is failing everyone.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with theologian Jeremiah Johnston to examine what may be the strongest physical evidence ever discovered for the resurrection of Jesus Christ, the Shroud of Turin. Johnston breaks down the latest scientific research confirming the authenticity of the Shroud and what it reveals about the crucifixion and resurrection, making the case that belief in the resurrection is not blind faith but a conclusion grounded in real historical and scientific evidence.
